review.description: S8 adds operational continue/resume for an interrupted retained review after its prior execution stops. New engineering instructions require a fresh prepared review rather than mutating the governing scope. Existing native same-thread messages, expected-turn fencing, drafts and deferred/terminated session rules remain intact.
review.implementation: QueueMessage routes marked review runs to queueReviewContinuation; startReviewWorkflow waits for reviewDone and validates unchanged configuration/evidence before checkpoint reuse. Session cancellation has a separate protected lifetime handle and cancels replacement admission after waiting for the run lock. Unmarked retained native runs keep their original routing. Retained QueueMessage continuation now takes the existing maintenance read gate before routing to review continuation; native empty-input ordering and the exclusive plugin/dependency maintenance owner remain unchanged.
review.tests: Read TestReviewInterruptResumeJoinsOldExecution: immediate resume rejects a still-running cancelled worker, changed scope is rejected and continue completes after join. TestReviewTerminationCancelsConcurrentStartAndResume checks the replacement execution is cancelled while pre-lock cancellation of old work remains available. Existing native admission/cancellation assertions remain mapped; the new behavior does not broaden host-message acceptance claims. Read TestRetainedReviewContinuationHonorsPluginMaintenance for continue/resume across fixture and production adapters: maintenance refusal mutates no run/session/message or work counters, release preserves capability/stale-turn refusals, and valid continuation reuses the completed checkpoint.
